# Demo: Failures, Logs, and Stale Artifacts

Day-2 diagnostics: external kill into CRASHED state, recovery via start, Stale Artifact detection in status and inspect, raw logs (-n, --err, --path), and secret redaction.

## Step 1: Baseline healthy LOCAL slice prior to failure and staleness checks

```console
$ procomp profile use orders-local

$ procomp gateway start

$ procomp gateway reconcile

$ procomp start
broker: spawned MANAGED (procomp) [PID 10001, HEALTHY]
orders: spawned MANAGED (procomp) [PID 10002, HEALTHY]

Summary: 3 started, 0 reused.

$ procomp status
```
